title: Automatic reminders show 'on' but not who they will reach
what: The automatic reminders page shows each reminder as on or off and '9 of 11 on', but never says how many members will actually get them. They only reach members who have the app, are linked to the gym, allow notifications and open the app. The manual message page does show 'In the app: N. Not in the app: M', so the owner can see reach there but not here.
expected: Each reminder shows how many members it will reach and how many it will miss, and why (no app, notifications off, no birthday saved).
how_often: every time the owner opens automatic reminders
fix_line: Show a reach count per reminder, using the same app-member count the manual message page already has

title: No record that an automatic reminder was ever sent
what: Members' phones set the automatic reminders themselves. The server only keeps the owner's on/off choices; nothing records that a birthday wish or plan-ending reminder went to a member, when, or why it did not. The owner believes they run but cannot check one.
expected: A record per member and reminder (went, when, or why not) that the owner or HQ can open.
fix_line: Have the phone report each reminder it shows, and list them on the member page

title: WhatsApp suggestions repeat what the automatic reminder already sent
what: The panel suggests a WhatsApp 'Plan ending', 'Birthday' or 'Welcome' message for a member without knowing whether the automatic reminder for the same thing already went to that member's phone. The member can get the same message twice.
expected: The WhatsApp suggestion notes when the member has the app and the matching automatic reminder is on, or drops that suggestion.
how_often: every member with the app whose plan ends, birthday or join day comes up
fix_line: Let the WhatsApp suggestions read the automatic reminder switches and the member's app status

title: 'Not sent when the member already renewed' depends on the member opening the app
what: The reminder page promises the plan-ending reminder is not sent when the member renewed. The phone sets reminders itself and only learns of a renewal or a changed setting when the member next opens the app. A member who renews at the desk and does not open the app can still get 'your plan ends' reminders.
expected: A renewal at the desk stops the plan-ending reminder whether or not the member opened the app.
how_often: cannot be proven in the cloud, needs a real-phone check
fix_line: Send a quiet push on renewal that makes the phone cancel its plan-ending reminders, or narrow the promise

title: Birthday wish depends on a date of birth that may be blank
what: The birthday wish and the 'Birthdays today' tile need a date of birth on the member page; with none, the member is silently skipped. How many Crispy Curves members have one was not counted in this step (no database query allowed).
expected: The reminder page says how many members have no date of birth and offers a way to fill it.
fix_line: Count members missing a date of birth next to the birthday switch

title: Urgent alerts can be dropped silently, and the owner never sees if one went
what: An urgent alert (a complaint, a check-in number) not pushed within 6 hours is marked 'late' and never sent. An alert is marked sent before the push company confirms delivery. Whether an alert went, was late or reached nobody is shown only for the test alert, never for real ones.
expected: Each real alert shows whether it was pushed, late, or reached nobody, and a missed urgent alert is flagged.
how_often: when the push job is down more than 6 hours or a browser address is broken
fix_line: Show the delivery state on each alert in the bell and tell HQ when urgent alerts go late

title: Member pop-ups are counted on the server but nobody can see them
what: The server keeps a count of pop-ups sent for each new message or offer, but the panel never reads it. The owner cannot see whether a message popped up on members' phones or how many.
expected: Each sent message shows how many phones it popped up on.
fix_line: Show 'popped up on N phones' under each sent message

title: What's new promises a phone notification with no conditions
what: Two What's new lines tell owners the member 'gets a notification on their phone' for trainer replies, approved pauses, reports and shop orders. That only happens for members with a recent app version, linked to the gym, with notifications allowed, on Android. A later line on messages does state the conditions; these two do not.
expected: The lines say which members get the notification, like the messages line does.
how_often: every owner who reads What's new
fix_line: Add 'members with the app and notifications on' to both lines

title: iPhone members get no notifications, and the owner is never told
what: The phone app's own note says every notification is still off on iPhone. The owner's panel says 'Members with the MettleUp app get these on their phone' and counts iPhone members as 'in the app'. Reminders, gym messages and reply alerts reach no iPhone member, silently.
expected: The panel counts iPhone members apart and says they do not get pop-ups yet.
how_often: cannot be proven in the cloud, needs a real-phone check
fix_line: Mark iPhone members in the reach counts until iPhone notifications ship

title: Member What's new promises pop-ups to iPhone members too
what: The app's What's new tells every member that gym messages now pop up right away, even when the app is closed. The list has no phone-type filter, so an iPhone member reads it, but iPhone notifications are off.
expected: Lines about pop-ups are hidden on iPhone, or say 'on Android'.
how_often: every iPhone member who opens What's new
fix_line: Let a What's new line say which phones it is for

title: Some app crashes never reach the team
what: A crash report refused by the server (any answer from 400 to 499 except 404) counts as delivered. A report made with no internet is dropped, not kept for later. Only crashes nothing caught and screen crashes are reported; failed background tasks are not hooked. The team can think a version is crash-free when it is not.
expected: Refused or offline reports are kept and retried; background failures are reported too.
how_often: every crash on a phone with no internet, or a refused report
fix_line: Keep unsent reports on the phone and send them on the next start

title: Members on the early download copy have no way onto the Play Store copy
what: Members who installed the early copy from the download page update only from that page. The Play copy carries a different key, so it cannot install over theirs, and nothing in the app tells them how to move. If the download page stops getting new versions, they are stuck.
expected: A one-time card that tells these members how to move to the Play copy without losing workouts.
fix_line: Add a move-to-Play card for download-page copies, after sign-in keeps their workouts

title: No warning when 'Rest is over' cannot ring
what: The rest-alert warning row only runs on Android. On iPhone, where app notifications are off, it shows nothing. On Android, if checking the alert permission fails, the error is swallowed and the row also shows nothing. Either way the member is told nothing and the rest alert may not ring.
expected: The member sees a warning whenever the rest alert cannot be confirmed to work.
how_often: cannot be proven in the cloud, needs a real-phone check
fix_line: Show 'Rest alerts may not ring' when the check fails or on iPhone

title: A workout in progress can vanish with no message
what: When the app restarts mid-workout and the saved copy of that workout cannot be read, the app treats it as 'no saved workout' with no message and no log. The member's half-done workout is gone and they are not told.
expected: The member is told the workout could not be restored, and the failure is logged.
how_often: rare: only when the phone's storage read fails at start
fix_line: Log the failure and show a one-line notice instead of starting empty

title: Changing 'one dumbbell or both' can fail to save, silently
what: When a member switches how an exercise's weight counts, the save and the re-read of their records swallow any error. If the save fails, the old setting comes back next time and records are compared in the wrong counting, with no message.
expected: A failed save is logged and the member is told it did not stick.
how_often: rare: only when the phone's storage write fails
fix_line: Log the failure and show a short notice
